data.title: Amazon and Meta are negotiating the future of AI shopping. Consumers aren't quite there yet.
data.summary: Amazon and Meta are negotiating the future of AI shopping. Consumers aren't quite there yet. Amazon (AMZN) and Meta (META) are in talks to restore access to the e-commerce platform for Meta's popular personal AI agent Muse, Fortune reported Wednesday. Amazon blocked Muse in September to safeguard its nearly $70 billion advertising business, as AI agents could allow shoppers to bypass sponsored product listings. [...] Renewed discussions between Amazon and Meta come after Walmart announced on Tuesday that its Black Friday deals can be shopped directly through Muse. Walmart touts that the agent can "find items, build a basket and complete their purchase" with a key search and price point in mind, like "Black Friday TV deal under $500." [...] While 31% of shoppers surveyed in the US, UK, Canada, and Australia have tried a personal AI agent, only 19% of those users have used one at checkout, according to a recent Salesforce (CRM) survey. That works out to roughly 6% of those polled. This holiday shopping season will be a major testing ground for agentic commerce. Salesforce expects AI to influence more than one in five holiday orders, including by helping shoppers research and discover products.
